newsitem.title: USA: Community files for 1.2 mln in securities.
newsitem.headline: Community files for 1.2 mln in securities.

text.p: A business trust formed by Community Trust Bancorp Inc filed a shelf registration with Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 1.2 million cumulative trust preferred securities.
The trust, known as CTBI Preferred Capital Trust I, will use the proceeds from the offering to invest in subordinated debentures of Community Trust.

The company intends to add the proceeds from the sale of the debentures to its general funds to be used for expansion through new branches and acquisitions, to fund growth in the company's indirect consumer loan portfolio and for general corporate purposes.

The preferred securities have a liquidition amount of $25 per preferred securities. The underwriters, led by Morgan Keegan & Co Inc, have been granted an over-allotment option to purchase up to 180,000 additional securities.
Community Trust, based in Pikeville, Kentucky, is a bank holding company.
